LESSON: CLASSES OF FIRE

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: INTEGRATED SCIENCE
Strand: Mixtures, Elements and Compounds
Topic 1.3: Classes of fire

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Classes of fire. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: where they can be seen. What are the dangers of fire in nature?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify causes of fire in nature
2. explain the role of the components of fire triangle in the spread of fire
3. describe ways of controlling different classes of fires

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. identify causes of fire in nature
   In simple words: practise until you can identify causes of fire in nature. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. explain the role of the components of fire triangle in the spread of fire
   In simple words: practise until you can explain the role of the components of fire triangle in the spread of fire. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

3. describe ways of controlling different classes of fires
   In simple words: practise until you can describe ways of controlling different classes of fires. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Classes of fire using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Classes of fire in the examples.
2. Explain Classes of fire to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Classes of fire.
4. Show that you can: identify causes of fire in nature

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Classes of fire using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Classes of fire important for a Grade 8 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Discuss the possible causes of fire in nature,
2. Discuss the role of the components of fire triangle in the spread of fire,
3. Discuss the dangers of fires in the environment,
4. Collaboratively practice fire control measures,
5. Discuss rights to safety information on flammable substances,

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. identify causes of fire in nature
2. explain the role of the components of fire triangle in the spread of fire
3. describe ways of controlling different classes of fires

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
